interface.title: Pediatric Status Asthmaticus Ventilation Simulator (v1.8.1, Streamlit)
interface.field: Pediatric critical care / respiratory physiology education
interface.stage_of_work: teaching and exploring 'what if' cases with a mechanistic physiology model
interface.what_it_is_for: Simulate how ventilator settings, airway obstruction and drug therapies combine to cause dynamic hyperinflation, auto-PEEP, high plateau pressure, low blood pressure and changes in PaCO2/EtCO2 in a ventilated child with severe asthma, and compare two strategies side by side.

data.note: 9 bundled YAML scenarios: excess_external_peep_passive, high_rr_dynamic_hyperinflation, high_vt_barotrauma_risk, ketamine_bronchodilation_response, post_intubation_collapse, safe_controlled_hypoventilation, severe_obstruction_rr_reference, silent_chest_low_etco2 and spontaneous_autopeep_peep_titration. Every result is computed in the app. There is no upload and no login. The Arrow/NumPy problem is fixed: all charts and tables rendered. Switching the base scenario inside a session left some controls at the previous scenario's values (obstruction severity stayed 'critical', heterogeneity stayed 1.40), while others reset (RR, Raw, VT). Reloading the page gave clean defaults.

tree.general: Understand how intervention settings and disease severity interact in a mechanistic model, and compare strategies
tree.specific: Learn how ventilator strategy and airway obstruction drive auto-PEEP, trapped volume, Pplat, MAP and PaCO2 in pediatric status asthmaticus

features.name: Preset scenario loader with editable parameter panel
features.general: Pick a named preset case, which fills a panel of grouped parameter controls; adjust any control and the model reruns
features.specific: Base scenario dropdown fills the sidebar groups (Scenario controls, Patient, Airway mechanics, Ventilator, Therapies); sliders and dropdowns override the YAML values and trigger a rerun. Switching scenario within a session can leave some controls (obstruction severity, heterogeneity, patient values) at the previous values; a page reload gives clean defaults

change a slider or dropdown (RR, I:E, obstruction severity)
reload the page before switching scenarios to get clean defaults

features.name: Headline outcome cards with risk badges and threshold alert banner
features.general: Show the key outcomes of the current run as summary cards with traffic-light risk badges, plus a banner listing which safety thresholds were crossed, all recomputed on every input change
features.specific: Metric cards (max auto-PEEP, max Pplat, final PaCO2, min MAP, min pH, VEI proxy), barotrauma and hemodynamic risk badges (LOW/WARNING) and the alert banner above the tabs, which carries the same threshold bullets as the Teaching summary
steps: change a setting and watch cards, badges and banner update
serves_tasks: Load a preset case and read its summary metrics and warnings
Raise the cycling rate and watch trapped-gas pressure grow
Shorten exhalation time relative to inhalation
Undo the harmful setting and see the trade-off

features.name: Mode-dependent and toggle-revealed controls
features.general: The choice of operating mode decides which setpoint control is shown, and turning on an optional treatment reveals its dose control
features.specific: Mode VCV shows 'VT (mL/kg)', PCV shows 'PC above PEEP (cmH2O)'; checking Ketamine reveals 'Ketamine infusion (mg/kg/h)'; checking 'Steroid already given' shows 'Minutes since steroid'
steps: choose PCV and see the setpoint slider swap
serves_tasks: Switch control mode and add treatments

features.name: Tabbed multi-series time-course charts
features.general: Group the output signals into themed tabs of line charts over time, with fullscreen and image export
features.specific: Pressures / Gas exchange / Hemodynamics / Mechanics tabs, each a Vega-Lite line chart over time_min; '…' menu saves SVG/PNG; fullscreen button
steps: open the '…' menu and Save as PNG or SVG
serves_tasks: View the time course of each output group
Save a chart as an image

features.name: Two-scenario comparison with delta table, overlays and CSV export
features.general: Run the current case against a second chosen case; show a per-metric table of primary, comparator, difference, unit and a better/worse label, overlay their time courses, and export the table
features.specific: Strategy comparison tab: Comparator scenario dropdown → Summary delta table (Max auto-PEEP, Pplat, VEI, final PaCO2, min pH, min MAP, max global risk) → Overlay curves (Primary vs Comparator auto-PEEP/Pplat, PaCO2/pH, MAP/risk) → Download comparison delta CSV. Delta = comparator − primary, and the better/worse label describes the comparator relative to the primary (PaCO2 is labelled context-dependent). The primary includes any sidebar edits, so an edited case can be compared with its own unedited preset
steps: read the delta table, remembering labels rate the comparator against the primary
serves_tasks: Compare two preset strategies by metric deltas and overlaid curves
Compare an edited case against its unedited preset

features.name: Rule-based teaching summary
features.general: Turn threshold crossings in the simulated outputs into plain-language explanatory bullets that change with the inputs, next to fixed notes on model limits
features.specific: Teaching summary tab: 'Automatic teaching summary' bullets (Pplat > 30, VEI > 20 mL/kg, MAP < 55, pH < 7.20, EtCO2 much lower than PaCO2), or a low-risk envelope message when none fire, plus 'Model boundary' and 'Variables reviewers may question'. No worked causal-chain view

not_done: The Te/tau_exp → trapped volume → auto-PEEP → Pplat → MAP chain is not shown as an explicit worked chain anywhere in the interface; the Teaching summary has only threshold bullets and generic text. The chain was put together by hand from the Mechanics tab (tau_exp, trapped volume), the Data tab (te_s, tau_exp_s) and the metric cards, so this goal is only partly met by the interface.

Saw a scenario-switch carry-over: going from safe_controlled_hypoventilation (with obstruction changed to critical) to high_rr_dynamic_hyperinflation kept 'critical', heterogeneity 1.40 and the patient values, while RR, Raw and VT reset. Checked only once. The five-bullet teaching summary in t11 (screens/030) was read in this carried-over state; t9, t10 and t5 come from a page reload; t6–t8 are stacked edits on one session.

Only one of the 'better/worse' labels in the delta table was checked against its own reading. In screens/044 a lower comparator Pplat is labelled 'better' while a higher comparator auto-PEEP is labelled 'worse', so the labels describe the comparator relative to the primary, which is easy to misread.
